name: ap-rif-orchestrator
description: Dev orchestrator that Dockerizes the repos under ./repos and lets you bring up any subset with one command.

scripts.docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.all.yml --profile all up --build
scripts.docker:local: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local.yml --profile all up --build
scripts.docker:remote: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.remote.yml --profile fe up --build
scripts.docker:down: docker compose --profile all --profile be --profile fe down
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose --profile be run --rm backend dotnet run --project AP.RTLA.Backend/AP.RTLA.Backend.csproj -- migrate
